question: Rohit Sharma became the first ever Indian to play how many T20 cricket matches in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**400**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohit Sharma** became the first ever Indian to play **400 T20 cricket matches** in October 2022.
 
• Rohit Sharma is an Indian cricketer and the** current captain of the Indian national team** in limited-overs formats.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the best limited-overs batsmen in the world.
 
• Sharma has numerous records to his name, including the **highest individual score in a One Day International **(ODI) match.
 
• His achievement of playing 400 T20 matches highlights his durability and consistent performance in the shortest format of the game.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rohit Sharma made his T20 debut in 2007 and has since become a key player for both his national team and franchise teams in various T20 leagues.
 
• He is known for his ability to play long innings and his exceptional skill in hitting sixes.
 
• In addition to his T20 achievements, Sharma has also been successful in Test and ODI cricket.
 
• He has been part of multiple IPL-winning teams, further solidifying his reputation as a top T20 player.
